label: Mithila
tagline: Land of Art, Philosophy & the Goddess Sita
description: Mithila is the cultural region of north Bihar associated with Maithili language and literature, the Ramayana tradition, Madhubani painting, and a rich corpus of living folk and ritual practices.

highlights.title: Vidyapati Sangeet
highlights.description: The Maithili song tradition associated with poet Vidyapati, including devotional and ceremonial songs that remain part of Mithila's oral repertoire.

highlights.title: Saurath Sabha
highlights.description: A traditional Maithil matrimonial gathering in Saurath, Madhubani, historically involving genealogists (Panjikars) and genealogical records in marriage negotiations.
highlights.image_note: A site-specific contemporary photograph should be supplied or sourced separately; do not use a generic wedding photograph.

label: Bhojpur
tagline: Land of Warriors, Folk Songs & the Ganges Plain
description: The Bhojpur cultural region is associated with Bhojpuri language and oral traditions, folk theatre, music, and the history of resistance represented by Veer Kunwar Singh and the 1857 uprising.

highlights.title: Bhojpuri Folk Music
highlights.description: A broad oral tradition of Bhojpuri songs associated with birth, marriage, agriculture, seasons, devotion and separation, including forms such as Sohar, Vivah Geet, Chaiti, Kajri and Birha.
highlights.image_note: Use a properly licensed photograph of Bhojpuri folk musicians or singers rather than a generic North Indian music image.

highlights.title: Aranya Devi Temple
highlights.description: A historic temple in Arrah associated with local religious traditions and the cultural landscape of Bhojpur.

label: Magadh
description: Magadh is the historical heartland of ancient Bihar, associated with the Mauryan and Gupta periods, Buddhist and Jain traditions, Pataliputra, Bodh Gaya, Nalanda and Rajgir.

label: Anga
tagline: Silk City, Sacred Rivers & Pala Learning
description: The historic Anga region is centered on Bhagalpur and is associated with ancient Anga, Bhagalpur silk, Manjusha art, Vikramashila and sacred sites such as Mandar Hill.

label: Bajjika
description: The Bajjika cultural zone in north-central Bihar is associated with Vaishali's ancient republican history, Buddhist and Jain heritage, the Champaran Satyagraha, and living craft and ritual traditions.

highlights.title: Champaran Satyagraha Heritage
highlights.description: The network of sites, memories and practices associated with Gandhi's 1917 Champaran Satyagraha, including Bhitiharwa Ashram and related locations.
